summary: Release a texture surface by index a2. Reads the flags dword at this+0x20; when bit 0x100 is set, clears that bit, releases the audio resource for the surface descriptor at this+0x50 (stride 0x40 bytes) via ArithmeticComparison_0f90 with the sound-manager global dword_8B78A0, and zeroes the +0x20 offset within the descriptor. Otherwise does nothing.

local_names.this: texture surface manager holding flags and the descriptor array
local_names.a2: surface index used to select the descriptor slot
local_names.v3: cached flags dword read from this+0x20

operations.description: Reads the flags dword v3 from this+0x20
Release path runs only while bit 0x100 (bit 8) is set in the flags dword at this+0x20
Clears bit 0x100: writes v3 & 0xFFFFFEFF back into this+0x20
Selects the surface descriptor: this+0x50 (pointer to 0x40-byte-stride descriptors) + (a2 << 6) + 0x1C
Releases the descriptor's audio resource: ArithmeticComparison_0f90(dword_8B78A0, *(descriptor + 0x1C))
Zeroes the +0x20 field of the selected surface descriptor
